prompt:
工程审计：原任务 PLAN-PATCHGATE-ESCROW-20261023 / PR259 head bab71e4974f427a0ca32dacfb1b111cad7de522b。只审下列完整GitHub工作流的事件、checkout、权限job隔离、输入是否shell注入、并发和归档；不要猜未展示的Node helper错误，列limitations。作者OpenAI，gate/helper的17项测试与全套184项本地过，默认A2=false，真实签名/实际execute workflow_id未登记，gate返回execute=false。明确约定：gate/run脚本校验固定main/context+严格六字段JSON，gate只读preflight/实际authority，run再次preflight并验证实际run身份；候选只被git fetch作为diff数据；签名从固定隔离ref读取并验gitblob及subject/check hash，调用旧guarded merger；不生成签名和模型内容。无原生签名器所以不是生产激活或真正自动合并。输出JSON verdict(approve|revise),findings[],limitations[]，裁定限定工作流。
name: PatchGate A2 docs executor
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request:
        description: Public collection identity JSON only; no tokens, policy, signatures or overrides
        required: true
        type: string
  pull_request:
    paths: [scripts/lib/patchgate-a2-executor.mjs,scripts/patchgate-a2-execute.mjs,scripts/tests/patchgate-a2-executor.test.mjs,.github/workflows/patchgate-a2-execute.yml]
permissions: {contents: read}
concurrency: {group: 'patchgate-a2-executor-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}', cancel-in-progress: false}
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - run: node --test scripts/tests/patchgate*.test.mjs
  gate:
    needs: verify
    if: github.repository == 'ltzyz2181-collab/ltzzz' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      execute: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.execute }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}', persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - id: gate
        name: Read only fixed main policy, stage audit and actual executor registration
        env:
          PATCHGATE_A2_REQUEST: ${{ inputs.request }}
        run: node scripts/patchgate-a2-execute.mjs gate "$RUNNER_TEMP/patchgate-a2-gate.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: patchgate-a2-gate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/patchgate-a2-gate.json
          retention-days: 30
  execute:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.execute == 'true' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write, actions: read, checks: read}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        # Entire executable tree is the triggering main commit. No PR checkout.
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}', persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - name: Execute only bound L0 evidence through the audited guarded merger
        env:
          PATCHGATE_A2_REQUEST: ${{ inputs.request }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/patchgate-a2-execute.mjs run "$RUNNER_TEMP/patchgate-a2-execution.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: patchgate-a2-execution-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/patchgate-a2-execution.json
          retention-days: 30
          # The guarded merger persists action outcomes on its isolated claim
          # branch. Never push main metadata before a source-bound merge.
